# growthbook_environments (Data Source)

Lists every GrowthBook environment in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_environments" "all" {}

output "environment_ids" {
  value = [for e in data.growthbook_environments.all.environments : e.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) All environments in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `default_state` (Boolean) Default enabled state for new features in this environment.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the environment.
- `id` (String) Environment id.
- `parent` (String) Id of the parent environment, if any.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this environment is scoped to.
- `toggle_on_list` (Boolean) Whether this environment appears in the feature list toggle.
